summary_1line: Vibhishana guides Lakshmana to Indrajit’s ritual site; Indrajit condemns his uncle’s betrayal while Vibhishana defends abandoning Ravana’s unrighteousness.

image_candidates.scene_text: Lakshmana stands with drawn bow beside Vibhishana in a dark forest as the massive Nyagrodha tree looms over Indrajit’s sacrificial ground.
Indrajit appears in a blazing chariot clad in armor, banner flying, confronting Lakshmana and angrily pointing at his uncle Vibhishana.
Vibhishana faces Indrajit amid the battlefield, calmly rebuking him while the young warrior rages in his chariot.
